Supabase Edge Functions run on Deno and are typechecked separately via supabase/functions/tsconfig.json — they are excluded here so browser-only DOM lib settings don't clash with Deno globals. Phase 1 Check 4: strict is ON (with useUnknownInCatchVariables, noImplicitReturns, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch, allowJs off) so the browser app has the same type baseline as the Edge Functions; the advanced flags exactOptionalPropertyTypes and noUncheckedIndexedAccess are ON as of Stage D. scripts/tsconfig-hygiene.test.mjs enforces these invariants.
